source.scope: Text path; excludes vision tower/aligner and quantization metadata.

model_params.active_params_note: Logical touched elements in backbone: one input embedding row, Top-K routed experts, 24 Engram rows/module, full LM head. Excludes DSpark.

compute.scope: Backbone teacher-forced forward for B*S tokens; major GEMMs and attention. No backward, kernel timing, or small elementwise/quantization operators.

memory.activation_estimate_kind: Unsharded sum of named forward tensors; NOT measured peak or exact backward-saved tensors.
memory.cache_scope: Logical populated inference caches, not training activations; owner storage counted once.

training_breakdown.note: One logical model copy; per-device numbers assume balanced sharding. Excludes activation peak, recompute, allocator/quantization metadata and communication overlap. CPU placement applies only to the configured parameter group, not its GPU computations.

details.note: Main LM head is independent; expansion into mHC streams is budgeted in mHC.
details.activation_policy: Explicit retained-tensor budget; not peak memory. Component inputs may alias neighbouring outputs; aggregate estimates intentionally do not deduplicate these boundary buffers or model lifetime overlap.
details.flops_scope: Forward GEMMs only (multiply-add=2); normalization, activation, routing/top-k, hashing, permutation, sampling and scalar arithmetic omitted.

details.activation_accounting: sum of named forward tensor sizes, including source-materialized index scores; not peak or autograd saved tensors
details.cache_accounting: logical filled caches plus allocated fp32 pooling state; owners only; no max-context preallocation, RoPE tables or quantization metadata
details.flops_accounting: major forward GEMMs plus valid sparse QK/AV; excludes elementwise, norm, softmax, topk, quantization and communication

notes: All displayed GB use 1e9 bytes. JSON carries raw bytes.
Model dimensions come from the pinned source config; precision, placement and sharding are analysis assumptions.
Training states use independent dtypes per parameter group. Engram momentum counts one state, not Adam's two.
Source inference code does not establish an official training optimizer/placement recipe; no runtime training is simulated.
Engram CPU placement moves the table and its states only; projection/gate and lookup tensors remain in GPU computations.
Per-device static assumes balanced shards; activation volume and inference caches are separate, not added into a claimed training peak.
Vision tower/aligner and quantization scales are excluded; source-created router bias_vl is retained.
